videos.topic: The Secret Silence Test in Dating
videos.emotional_trigger: deliberately waiting hours to reply to see if they will notice your absence
videos.core_claim: Withdrawing your effort to test whether someone notices never brings peace; it just confirms you already knew the relationship was one-sided.
videos.editorial_seed: When you stop texting first as a trap, you are secretly looking for proof to justify walking away. If you need someone to fail a silence test before you feel allowed to speak up, the answer is already in the room. Real safety comes from asking clearly, not staging your own disappearance.
videos.only_soft_reset_line: I was waiting for them to guess a question I could have just asked.
videos.hook: You read their text in two minutes. You answer it in four hours, so they can notice.
